Race reports from across the season list him as a Mercedes driver, including the Chinese, Saudi Arabian, Hungarian, Italian, Mexico City and Qatar Grands Prix. I did not check the season standings, but every 2025 result I found shows him with Mercedes.

ANSWER: Mercedes
